title: 67 boat strikes. 221 dead. The cocaine hasn’t slowed, officials report.
description: The president says Operation Southern Spear has virtually ended drug trafficking by sea. Pentagon and DEA analysts have concluded otherwise.

title: Source of false Buttigieg allegation appeared ‘mentally unstable,’ records show
description: The Michigan attorney general’s office is investigating how the accusation that prompted the ex-Cabinet secretary's separation from his 4-year-old twins was handled.

title: In Memphis, an 'anti-crime' task force quietly turned into an ICE crackdown
description: The influx of federal agents into the city last fall led to widespread immigration arrests – a majority without criminal convictions. President Trump has said he wants to replicate it elsewhere.

title: Kalshi attacks Wisconsin law banning election bets as 'voter suppression'
description: The spat between the leading prediction market company and a key battleground state could be a glimpse into the next major fight between states and the fast-growing industry.

title: Maine Democrats pick Troy Jackson to replace Graham Platner in Senate race
description: In Maine's U.S. Senate race, state Democrats have nominated Troy Jackson to replace the scandal-plagued candidate Graham Platner.

title: With just a few primary elections to go, the competitive Senate map keeps shifting
description: For Democrats to take control of the U.S. Senate, they have to flip 4 seats currently held by Republicans. Republicans, meanwhile, are playing defense and pickup opportunities are harder to find.

title: Republicans see ‘scary’ lack of enthusiasm among core voters ahead of midterms
description: Pollsters and GOP groups are raising the alarm about an unmotivated base in an election year that would be tough no matter what, given the president’s low approval.

title: Troy Jackson replaces Graham Platner as Democratic candidate in Maine's Senate Race
description: Maine Democrats have chosen their candidate to run against incumbent GOP Sen. Susan Collins. Troy Jackson, former state lawmaker, steps in where the scandal-plagued Graham Platner stepped out.

title: Politics chat: How the war with Iran will shape midterms, Troy Jackson enters Maine Senate race
description: We'll look at how the war with Iran might shape the outcome for the 2026 Midterm elections, as well as how the new Democratic senate candidate in Maine might fare against the Republican incumbent.

title: Rage-giving, innovation and cuts: How public media has survived without federal funds
description: A year after President Trump signed a law ending six decades of federal funding of public media, it's a time of reinvention, innovation and clear anxiety at public tv and radio stations nationwide.

title: Democrats pick new Senate candidate in Maine in aftermath of Platner debacle
description: Troy Jackson won his party's nomination by commandeering the progressive movement that fueled Graham Platner's rise. He will face off against GOP Sen. Susan Collins in November.

title: Biden ghostwriter tapes to be released
description: Former President Joe Biden is declining to appeal a court ruling that allows the Justice Department to publicize recordings of conversations between him and a writer collaborating on his memoir.

title: Week in Politics: Iran War; Trump attends solemn ritual; nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia
description: The Trump administration is seeking tens of billions of dollars in supplemental appropriations for the Iran War, a war which the president and allies have repeatedly claimed is already won.

title: Democrats in Maine formally nominate Troy Jackson as their new U.S. Senate candidate
description: Democrats are hoping to move past Graham Platner's scandal-plagued campaign as they look to unseat Susan Collins. In Jackson, they chose a nominee with a similar economic populist message as Platner.
